# Unkey Docs

> Unkey documentation for two products: Compute, which builds, deploys, and runs your app behind a gateway, and API Management, which issues API keys, enforces rate limits, and reports usage. Platform pages cover the workspace, billing, root keys, the CLI, and error codes shared by both.

> ## Agent Instructions
> Unkey is two separate products. Compute builds, deploys, and runs apps behind a gateway. API Management issues API keys, enforces rate limits, manages identities and permissions, and reports usage. Say which product a page belongs to; a reader can use either without the other.
> Every Unkey API endpoint is an HTTP POST to https://api.unkey.com/v2/{service}.{procedure} with a root key in the Authorization: Bearer header. Root keys are workspace scoped.
> Error codes have the form err:{system}:{category}:{specific} and each has a page at /errors/{system}/{category}/{specific}.
> The word environment means production or preview in Compute. Rate limiting has four meanings on this site; the glossary lists them.

- [Unkey documentation](https://unkey.com/docs/index.md): Deploy apps with Compute or add API keys to any app with API Management.
- [Platform](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/index.md): Manage what both Unkey products share: your workspace, billing, root keys, and the CLI.
- [Glossary](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/glossary.md): Look up the terms Unkey uses and which product each one belongs to.

- [Log drains](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/workspace/log-drains.md): Forward audit logs, verifications, gateway traffic, runtime logs, or rate limits to HTTP or Axiom.
- [Team](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/workspace/team.md): Invite people to your workspace and choose whether each one is an admin or a developer.
- [Two-factor authentication](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/workspace/two-factor-auth.md): Add a second factor to your Unkey sign-in from Account settings.
- [Audit logs](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/workspace/audit-logs/overview.md): Who changed what in your workspace, and how long the record is kept.
- [Audit log event types](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/workspace/audit-logs/event-types.md): Every event the audit log records and what triggers it.
- [Plans](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/billing/plans.md): See what the API Management tiers and Compute plans include and how a change takes effect.
- [Limits](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/billing/limits.md): See the limits your plan puts on your workspace.
- [Usage](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/billing/usage.md): Check what your workspace has used this month before the invoice arrives.
- [Root keys](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/root-keys/overview.md): Create and rotate the root keys that authenticate you to the Unkey API.
- [Root key permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/root-keys/permissions.md): Grant a root key exactly the operations it needs, and read the error when one is missing.
- [Permission reference](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/root-keys/permissions-legacy.md): Find the exact resource.id.action string a root key needs for each operation.
- [HTTP API basics](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api/overview.md): Call the Unkey API: one base URL, POST endpoints, and a shared response envelope.
- [API authentication](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api/authentication.md): Send your root key as a bearer token and read the errors a bad key returns.
- [RPC naming convention](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api/rpc-convention.md): Work out any endpoint's name from the POST /v2/{service}.{procedure} pattern.
- [API error envelope](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api/errors.md): Read the error object a failed request returns and find the page for its code.
- [Too many requests](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api/rate-limits.md): What a 429 from api.unkey.com means and what to do about it.
- [The unkey CLI](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/cli/overview.md): Run Unkey from your terminal with the unkey CLI and find the page for each command.
- [Install the CLI](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/cli/install.md): Install the unkey CLI from npm or a GitHub release and check its version.
- [CLI authentication](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/cli/authentication.md): Give the CLI a root key by flag, environment variable, or stored config.
- [CLI output and shared flags](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/cli/output-and-flags.md): Use the flags every unkey api command shares to pipe JSON or send a raw body.
- [unkey auth login](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/cli/auth/login.md): Store a root key locally so unkey api commands stop asking for it.
- [AI coding](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/ai-coding/overview.md): Connect your AI coding assistant to Unkey so it can manage your workspace and read the docs.
- [Unkey MCP servers](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/ai-coding/mcp-servers.md): Let an AI assistant manage your keys, APIs, and deployments through Unkey's hosted MCP servers.
- [Use Unkey with Claude Code](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/ai-coding/claude-code.md): Add the Unkey MCP servers and docs to Claude Code with one command each.
- [Use Unkey with Cursor](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/ai-coding/cursor.md): Add the Unkey MCP servers and docs to Cursor.
- [Connect other MCP clients](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/ai-coding/other-clients.md): Set up the Unkey MCP servers in VS Code, Claude Desktop, Codex CLI, or any other MCP client.
- [Security](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/security/overview.md): See how Unkey protects your keys and workspace and what you can turn on.
- [Key storage](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/security/key-storage.md): Know why Unkey shows a key only once and when you can get it back.
- [GitHub secret scanning](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/security/github-secret-scanning.md): Learn what happens when a root key leaks into a public GitHub repository.
- [Delete protection](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/security/delete-protection.md): Stop a keyspace, project, or app from being deleted by accident.
- [Error codes](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/overview.md): What every Unkey error code means and how to fix it.
- [assertion_failed](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/assertion_failed.md): A check that should never fail did, which means a bug on our side rather than a problem with your request.
- [deployment_is_current](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/deployment_is_current.md): The deployment is already the app's current deployment.
- [deployment_is_production](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/deployment_is_production.md): Production deployments cannot be stopped or started directly.
- [deployment_is_stopping](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/deployment_is_stopping.md): A stop is already in progress for this deployment.
- [deployment_no_current](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/deployment_no_current.md): The app has no current deployment, so there is nothing to promote or roll back from.
- [deployment_not_production](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/deployment_not_production.md): Only production deployments can be promoted or rolled back to.
- [deployment_not_ready](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/deployment_not_ready.md): The deployment to promote or roll back to is not ready to serve traffic.
- [deployment_not_running](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/deployment_not_running.md): The deployment is not running, so there is nothing to stop.
- [deployment_not_stopped](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/deployment_not_stopped.md): The deployment is not stopped, so there is nothing to start.
- [invalid_environment_settings](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/invalid_environment_settings.md): The environment's settings would fail the deploy pipeline, so the deployment was refused.
- [invalid_input](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/invalid_input.md): The request failed validation, either against the endpoint's schema or against a rule the endpoint checks in code.
- [precondition_failed](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/precondition_failed.md): The request was valid but the current state does not allow the operation yet.
- [protected_resource](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/protected_resource.md): The delete was refused because the resource has delete protection enabled.
- [unkey/application/service_unavailable](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/service_unavailable.md): The API failed on our side and couldn't complete the request, so retry with backoff.
- [unexpected_error](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/application/unexpected_error.md): Something failed on our side that has no more specific error code.
- [unkey/authentication/key_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/authentication/key_not_found.md): The bearer token is not a root key the API recognizes.
- [malformed](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/authentication/malformed.md): The Authorization header is not in the form Bearer <token>.
- [missing](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/authentication/missing.md): The endpoint didn't accept the kind of credential you sent, so it couldn't identify you.
- [portal_session_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/authentication/portal_session_not_found.md): The portal session token or exchange code is unknown, expired, or already used.
- [portal_token_missing](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/authentication/portal_token_missing.md): A portal endpoint was called without a portal session token.
- [forbidden](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/authorization/forbidden.md): The request is authenticated but not allowed, for a reason other than a missing permission.
- [unkey/authorization/insufficient_permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/authorization/insufficient_permissions.md): The root key is valid but lacks a permission this operation needs.
- [key_disabled](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/authorization/key_disabled.md): The root key used to authenticate has been disabled.
- [workspace_disabled](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/authorization/workspace_disabled.md): The workspace that owns the root key is disabled.
- [analytics_connection_failed](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/analytics_connection_failed.md): Analytics queries couldn't run because of a failure on our side, so retry with backoff.
- [analytics_not_configured](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/analytics_not_configured.md): Analytics isn't enabled for your workspace, so the analytics endpoints can't run.
- [api_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/api_not_found.md): The apiId does not match a live API in your workspace.
- [app_already_exists](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/app_already_exists.md): Another app in the project already uses that slug.
- [app_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/app_not_found.md): The app does not exist in the project.
- [audit_log_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/audit_log_not_found.md): A reserved code that no endpoint returns.
- [unkey/data/deployment_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/deployment_not_found.md): The deployment does not exist in your workspace.
- [domain_already_exists](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/domain_already_exists.md): The custom domain is already attached to your workspace.
- [domain_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/domain_not_found.md): The custom domain is not attached to your workspace.
- [environment_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/environment_not_found.md): The project, app, or environment in the request did not resolve.
- [identity_already_exists](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/identity_already_exists.md): An identity with that externalId already exists in the workspace.
- [identity_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/identity_not_found.md): The identity does not exist in your workspace.
- [key_auth_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/key_auth_not_found.md): The keyspaceId passed to the deprecated deploy.createDeployment does not exist.
- [unkey/data/key_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/key_not_found.md): The keyId in the request does not match a live key in your workspace.
- [key_space_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/key_space_not_found.md): A gateway key auth policy references a keyspace that does not exist in your workspace.
- [migration_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/migration_not_found.md): The migrationId passed to keys.migrateKeys does not exist in your workspace.
- [permission_already_exists](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/permission_already_exists.md): A permission with that slug already exists in the workspace.
- [permission_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/permission_not_found.md): A permission named in the request does not exist in the workspace.
- [policy_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/policy_not_found.md): The gateway policy id is not in the environment's current policy list.
- [portal_already_exists](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/portal_already_exists.md): The portal slug is taken, or the app or keyspace already has a portal.
- [portal_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/portal_not_found.md): No portal in your workspace matches the id, slug, app, or keyspace.
- [project_already_exists](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/project_already_exists.md): Another project in the workspace already uses that slug.
- [project_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/project_not_found.md): The project does not exist in your workspace.
- [ratelimit_namespace_gone](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/ratelimit_namespace_gone.md): The rate limit namespace was deleted, so ratelimit.limit refuses to use it.
- [ratelimit_namespace_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/ratelimit_namespace_not_found.md): The rate limit namespace does not exist in your workspace.
- [ratelimit_override_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/ratelimit_override_not_found.md): No rate limit override matches the identifier in that namespace.
- [role_already_exists](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/role_already_exists.md): A role with that name already exists in the workspace.
- [role_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/role_not_found.md): A role named in the request does not exist in the workspace.
- [workspace_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/data/workspace_not_found.md): The workspace the root key belongs to no longer exists.
- [custom_domain_limit_exceeded](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/unkey/limits/custom_domain_limit_exceeded.md): The workspace already has as many custom domains as its plan allows.
- [client_closed_request](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/client_closed_request.md): The client disconnected before the API finished handling the request.
- [invalid_analytics_function](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/invalid_analytics_function.md): The analytics query calls a ClickHouse function that is not on the allowlist.
- [invalid_analytics_query](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/invalid_analytics_query.md): The analytics query breaks one of the query rules, or failed when it ran.
- [invalid_analytics_query_type](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/invalid_analytics_query_type.md): The analytics query is not a SELECT statement.
- [invalid_analytics_table](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/invalid_analytics_table.md): The analytics query reads a table the endpoint does not expose.
- [missing_required_header](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/missing_required_header.md): A reserved code that no endpoint returns.
- [per_key_breakout_too_large](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/per_key_breakout_too_large.md): A portal analytics window covers more keys than the per-key breakout returns.
- [permissions_query_syntax_error](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/permissions_query_syntax_error.md): The permissions query passed to keys.verifyKey could not be parsed.
- [query_range_exceeds_retention](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/query_range_exceeds_retention.md): The analytics query asks for data older than the workspace's retention window.
- [request_body_too_large](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/request_body_too_large.md): The request body is larger than the 10 MiB the API accepts.
- [request_body_unreadable](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/request_body_unreadable.md): The API could not read the request body to the end.
- [request_timeout](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/bad_request/request_timeout.md): The request did not finish within the API's one minute deadline.
- [query_quota_exceeded](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/too_many_requests/query_quota_exceeded.md): Your workspace used up its analytics query quota for the current window.
- [workspace_rate_limited](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/too_many_requests/workspace_rate_limited.md): The workspace is sending too many requests to the Unkey API.
- [query_execution_timeout](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/unprocessable_entity/query_execution_timeout.md): The analytics query ran longer than its 10 second budget and was canceled.
- [query_memory_limit_exceeded](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/unprocessable_entity/query_memory_limit_exceeded.md): The analytics query used too much memory or its result exceeded 4 MiB.
- [query_rows_limit_exceeded](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/user/unprocessable_entity/query_rows_limit_exceeded.md): The analytics query read or returned more rows than the workspace allows.
- [deployment_offline](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/capacity/deployment_offline.md): The deployment behind this hostname was stopped or its project canceled.
- [no_running_instances](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/capacity/no_running_instances.md): The deployment has no running instance in any region right now.
- [spend_limit_reached](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/capacity/spend_limit_reached.md): Compute is paused because the workspace reached its monthly spend budget.
- [firewall_denied](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/client/firewall_denied.md): A gateway firewall policy matched the request and denied it.
- [frontline/client/insufficient_permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/client/insufficient_permissions.md): The API key verified but does not satisfy the gateway policy's permission query.
- [invalid_key](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/client/invalid_key.md): The API key in the request did not verify.
- [missing_credentials](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/client/missing_credentials.md): The gateway found no API key in the request.
- [openapi_validation_failed](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/client/openapi_validation_failed.md): The request does not match the OpenAPI spec the gateway validates against.
- [rate_limited](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/client/rate_limited.md): The request exceeded a per-key limit or a gateway rate limit policy.
- [usage_exceeded](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/client/usage_exceeded.md): The gateway rejected the request because the key has no credits left.
- [invalid_configuration](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/config/invalid_configuration.md): The deployment's gateway policy configuration could not be parsed or has an invalid value.
- [config_load_failed](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/platform/config_load_failed.md): Unkey's gateway failed on our side while loading the configuration it needs to route the request.
- [deployment_selection_failed](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/platform/deployment_selection_failed.md): A reserved gateway code that no request returns.
- [internal_server_error](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/platform/internal_server_error.md): Unkey's gateway failed on our side while handling the request.
- [config_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/routing/config_not_found.md): No Compute deployment is routed for the requested hostname.
- [frontline/routing/deployment_not_found](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/routing/deployment_not_found.md): A reserved gateway code that no request returns.
- [bad_gateway](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/upstream/bad_gateway.md): The app behind the gateway reset the connection or returned an unusable response.
- [gateway_timeout](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/upstream/gateway_timeout.md): The app behind the gateway did not respond before the deadline.
- [proxy_forward_failed](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/upstream/proxy_forward_failed.md): A reserved gateway code for failing to forward a request that no code path returns today.
- [frontline/upstream/service_unavailable](https://unkey.com/docs/errors/frontline/upstream/service_unavailable.md): The app instance refused the connection or could not be reached.
- [Create project](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/projects/create-project.md): Create a project to group deployments and applications under a workspace-scoped slug.
- [Get project](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/projects/get-project.md): Retrieve a single project in your workspace by its id.
- [List projects](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/projects/list-projects.md): Retrieve a paginated list of projects in your workspace.
- [Update project](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/projects/update-project.md): Update an existing project in your workspace, identified by its id.
- [Delete project](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/projects/delete-project.md): Delete an existing project in your workspace, identified by its id.
- [Create app](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/apps/create-app.md): Create an app within a project. The app is created with default `production` and `preview` environments.
- [Get app](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/apps/get-app.md): Retrieve a single app by its id or slug within a project.
- [List apps](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/apps/list-apps.md): Retrieve a paginated list of apps within a project.
- [Update app](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/apps/update-app.md): Update an existing app, identified by its id.
- [Delete app](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/apps/delete-app.md): Delete an existing app, identified by its id.
- [List environments](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/environments/list-environments.md): Retrieve the environments within an app.
- [Get environment](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/environments/get-environment.md): Retrieve a single environment by its id.
- [Update environment settings](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/environments/update-environment-settings.md): Update the build, runtime, and regional settings for an environment.
- [List environment variables](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/environments/list-environment-variables.md): Retrieve the environment variables for an environment.
- [Set environment variables](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/environments/set-environment-variables.md): Create or update environment variables for an environment in a single atomic request.
- [Remove environment variables](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/environments/remove-environment-variables.md): Remove environment variables from an environment in a single atomic request.
- [Create deployment](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/deployments/create-deployment.md): Create a deployment for an app in a project.
- [Get deployment](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/deployments/get-deployment.md): Retrieve a single deployment by its id.
- [List deployments](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/deployments/list-deployments.md): Retrieve a paginated list of deployments within a workspace, newest first.
- [Promote deployment](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/deployments/promote-deployment.md): Promote a deployment to become the current deployment for its environment. All sticky domains are reassigned from the current deployment to the promoted one, and the previous deployment is scheduled for standby.
- [Rollback deployment](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/deployments/rollback-deployment.md): Roll live traffic back to a previous deployment. `deploymentId` is the deployment to roll back TO; the app's current deployment is used as the rollback source automatically.
- [Start deployment](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/deployments/start-deployment.md): Start a deployment that was previously stopped with `stopDeployment`, so it serves traffic again. The deployment keeps the configuration it had when it was stopped; nothing is rebuilt or redeployed.
- [Stop deployment](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/deployments/stop-deployment.md): Stop a running preview deployment. Stopped deployments keep their configuration and can be resumed later with `startDeployment`.
- [Create domain](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/domains/create-domain.md): Attach a custom domain to an environment and start verifying it.
- [Get domain](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/domains/get-domain.md): Retrieve a custom domain and its verification status.
- [List domains](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/domains/list-domains.md): List your custom domains with their verification status and DNS records. Filter by project, app, or environment using IDs or slugs, or send `{}` to list domains across your workspace.
- [Verify domain](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/domains/verify-domain.md): Restart verification for a custom domain.
- [Delete domain](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/domains/delete-domain.md): Delete a custom domain from your workspace.
- [List policies](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/gateway/list-policies.md): Retrieve an environment's gateway policies in evaluation order: the gateway evaluates them top to bottom and the first rejection short-circuits the request.
- [Set policies](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/gateway/set-policies.md): Replace an environment's gateway policies in a single atomic request. Policies run at the edge before requests reach your app: verify API keys, rate limit, block requests outright, or validate them against your OpenAPI spec.
- [Update policy](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/gateway/update-policy.md): Update a single policy in place without resending the environment's full policy list. The policy keeps its id and its position in the evaluation order, and all other policies are untouched.
- [Install GitHub App](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/github/install-github-app.md): Start installing the Unkey GitHub App for your workspace. Returns a GitHub App install URL: open it in a browser to install the app and grant repository access. After installation GitHub returns to Unkey, which binds the installation to your workspace and lands you in the workspace settings.
- [Query gateway request data](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/analytics/query-gateway-request-data.md): A query can use only the public alias `gateway_requests_v1`. CTEs, subqueries, UNION, and EXCEPT are permitted. The root key must have the `project.*.read_gateway_requests` permission. Unkey limits each query to the workspace of the root key. To get the data for one project, app, or environment, add…
- [Query runtime log data](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/analytics/query-runtime-log-data.md): A query can use only the public alias `runtime_logs_v1`. CTEs, subqueries, UNION, and EXCEPT are permitted. The root key must have the `project.*.read_runtime_logs` permission. Unkey limits each query to the workspace of the root key. To get the logs of one project, app, environment, or deployment,…

- [Delete API namespace](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/apis/delete-api-namespace.md): Permanently delete an API namespace and immediately invalidate all associated keys.
- [Get API namespace](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/apis/get-api-namespace.md): Retrieve basic information about an API namespace including its ID and name.
- [List API keys](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/apis/list-api-keys.md): Retrieve a paginated list of API keys for dashboard and administrative interfaces.
- [Add key permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/keys/add-key-permissions.md): Add permissions to a key without affecting existing permissions.
- [Add key roles](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/keys/add-key-roles.md): Add roles to a key without affecting existing roles or permissions.
- [Create API key](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/keys/create-api-key.md): Create a new API key for user authentication and authorization.
- [Delete API keys](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/keys/delete-api-keys.md): Delete API keys from user accounts or for cleanup purposes.
- [Get API key](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/keys/get-api-key.md): Retrieve detailed key information for dashboard interfaces and administrative purposes.

- [Reroll Key](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/keys/reroll-key.md): Generate a new API key while preserving the configuration from an existing key.
- [Set key permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/keys/set-key-permissions.md): Replace all permissions on a key with the specified set in a single atomic operation.
- [Set key roles](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/keys/set-key-roles.md): Replace all roles on a key with the specified set in a single atomic operation.

- [Create Identity](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/identities/create-identity.md): Create an identity to group multiple API keys under a single entity. Identities enable shared rate limits and metadata across all associated keys.
- [Delete Identity](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/identities/delete-identity.md): Permanently delete an identity. This operation cannot be undone.
- [Get Identity](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/identities/get-identity.md): Retrieve an identity by external ID. Returns metadata, rate limits, and other associated data.
- [List Identities](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/identities/list-identities.md): Get a paginated list of all identities in your workspace. Returns metadata and rate limit configurations.
- [Update Identity](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/identities/update-identity.md): Update an identity's metadata and rate limits. Only specified fields are modified - others remain unchanged.
- [Create permission](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/permissions/create-permission.md): Create a new permission to define specific actions or capabilities in your RBAC system. Permissions can be assigned directly to API keys or included in roles.
- [Create role](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/permissions/create-role.md): Create a new role to group related permissions for easier management. Roles enable consistent permission assignment across multiple API keys. Permission slugs supplied in `permissions` are attached during creation. Missing permissions are created automatically.
- [Delete permission](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/permissions/delete-permission.md): Remove a permission from your workspace. This also removes the permission from all API keys and roles.
- [Delete role](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/permissions/delete-role.md): Remove a role from your workspace. This also removes the role from all assigned API keys.
- [Get permission](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/permissions/get-permission.md): Retrieve details about a specific permission including its name, description, and metadata.
- [Get role](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/permissions/get-role.md): Retrieve details about a specific role including its assigned permissions.
- [List permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/permissions/list-permissions.md): Retrieve all permissions in your workspace. Results are paginated and sorted by their id.
- [List roles](https://unkey.com/docs/platform/api-reference/permissions/list-roles.md): Retrieve all roles in your workspace including their assigned permissions. Results are paginated and sorted by their id.

An empty `permissions` array removes every permission from the role. Permissions that do not exist are created when the caller has permission to create them.

- [Listing keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keyspaces/listing-keys.md): Page through the keys in a keyspace or find the ones a user owns.
- [Creating keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/creating-keys.md): Every field you can set when you create a key, with its limits.
- [Updating keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/updating-keys.md): Change a key in place, and clear a field rather than recreating the key.
- [Verifying keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/verifying-keys.md): Check a key on every request and act on the result.
- [Credits and refill](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/credits-and-refill.md): Give keys a spendable balance that refills on a schedule.
- [Key expiration](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/expiration.md): Give a key an expiry so it stops working at a moment you choose.
- [Disabling and deleting keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/enable-disable-delete.md): Suspend a key for now or delete it so it never works again.
- [Rerolling keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/rerolling-keys.md): Replace a key's secret while keeping its configuration and a grace period.
- [Metadata and tags](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/metadata-and-tags.md): Attach data to a key and to each verification of it.
- [Recoverable keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/recoverable-keys.md): Store an encrypted copy of a key so you can show it again later.
- [Looking up keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/looking-up-keys.md): Read a key's configuration by its id or from the key itself.
- [Migrating existing keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/keys/migrating-keys.md): Bring existing keys from another system into Unkey without rotating them.
- [Rate limiting](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/ratelimiting/overview.md): Choose between the standalone rate limit API and limits attached to keys.
- [How rate limiting works](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/ratelimiting/how-it-works.md): Know how requests are counted, what a rate limit response tells you, and how exact the counts are across regions.
- [ratelimit.limit and multiLimit](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/ratelimiting/limit-and-multi-limit.md): Rate limit any identifier with one call, or several limits at once.
- [Rate limit overrides](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/ratelimiting/overrides.md): Give one identifier or a pattern its own limit without changing code.
- [Key and identity rate limits](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/ratelimiting/key-and-identity-limits.md): Enforce named rate limits on a key or an identity during verification.
- [Identities](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/identities/overview.md): Tie a user's keys together so they share metadata and rate limits.
- [Shared rate limits across keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/identities/shared-rate-limits.md): Put one rate limit on a user so all of their keys share it.
- [Authorization](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/authorization/overview.md): Control what each key may do with permissions checked at verification.
- [Roles and permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/authorization/roles-and-permissions.md): Define the permissions your API checks and group them into roles.
- [Permission queries](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/authorization/permission-queries.md): Ask for the permissions a request needs when you verify a key.
- [Managing key roles and permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/authorization/managing-key-permissions.md): Change the roles and permissions a key holds after it exists.
- [Analytics](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/analytics/overview.md): Query your key verification and rate limit data with SQL.
- [Analytics query language](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/analytics/query-language.md): Write SQL against your verification and rate limit data.
- [Analytics restrictions and quotas](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/analytics/restrictions-and-quotas.md): The limits every analytics query runs under and the error each one returns.
- [key_verifications tables](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/analytics/tables/key-verifications.md): Every column in the key verification tables and their rollups.
- [ratelimits tables](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/analytics/tables/ratelimits.md): Every column in the rate limit tables and their rollups.
- [Analytics query examples](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/analytics/examples.md): Copy-ready SQL for the questions people ask most about verifications and rate limits.
- [Analytics troubleshooting](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/analytics/troubleshooting.md): Fix empty results, rejected queries, and timeouts.
- [Developer portal](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/portal/overview.md): A hosted page where your users manage their own API keys.
- [Portal sessions](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/portal/sessions.md): Sign a user into the portal from your backend.
- [What portal users can do](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/portal/end-user-experience.md): What your users see and can do inside the portal.
- [API key security](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/security/overview.md): How the keys you issue are protected, from storage to leak detection.
- [Recovering keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/security/recovering-keys.md): What you give up when a keyspace lets plaintext keys be read back.
- [Cookbook](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cookbook/index.md): Recipes for rate limiting, billing, and framework middleware built on Unkey.
- [Per-user rate limits](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cookbook/per-user-rate-limit.md): Rate limit a user across all of their keys.
- [Per-endpoint rate limits](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cookbook/endpoint-rate-limit.md): Give each endpoint its own rate limit budget.
- [Usage-based billing with credits](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cookbook/usage-billing.md): Meter and bill API usage with credits.
- [Tiered subscriptions](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cookbook/tiered-subscriptions.md): Model free, pro, and enterprise plans on a key.
- [Go middleware for net/http, Gin, and Echo](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cookbook/go-middleware.md): Drop-in key verification middleware for net/http, Gin, and Echo.
- [FastAPI authentication](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cookbook/fastapi-auth.md): Verify API keys in FastAPI with a typed dependency.

- [unkey api keys remove-roles](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cli/keys/remove-roles.md): Remove roles from a key without touching its direct permissions.

- [unkey api keys set-roles](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cli/keys/set-roles.md): Replace the roles of a key with a new set.
- [unkey api keys update-credits](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cli/keys/update-credits.md): Set or adjust the remaining credits on a key.
- [unkey api keys update-key](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cli/keys/update-key.md): Change the settings of an existing key without reissuing it.
- [unkey api keys verify-key](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cli/keys/verify-key.md): Verify a key the way your API would on a request.

- [unkey api permissions delete-role](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/cli/permissions/delete-role.md): Delete a role and remove it from every key that has it.

- [Get API namespace](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/apis/get-api-namespace.md): Retrieve basic information about an API namespace including its ID and name.

- [Add key roles](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/add-key-roles.md): Add roles to a key without affecting existing roles or permissions.
- [Create API key](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/create-api-key.md): Create a new API key for user authentication and authorization.
- [Delete API keys](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/delete-api-keys.md): Delete API keys from user accounts or for cleanup purposes.
- [Get API key](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/get-api-key.md): Retrieve detailed key information for dashboard interfaces and administrative purposes.
- [Migrate API key(s)](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/migrate-api-keys.md): Returns HTTP 200 even on partial success; hashes that could not be migrated are listed under `data.failed`.
- [Remove key permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/remove-key-permissions.md): Remove permissions from a key without affecting existing roles or other permissions.
- [Remove key roles](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/remove-key-roles.md): Remove roles from a key without affecting direct permissions or other roles.
- [Reroll Key](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/reroll-key.md): Generate a new API key while preserving the configuration from an existing key.
- [Set key permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/set-key-permissions.md): Replace all permissions on a key with the specified set in a single atomic operation.
- [Set key roles](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/set-key-roles.md): Replace all roles on a key with the specified set in a single atomic operation.
- [Update key credits](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/update-key-credits.md): Update credit quotas in response to plan changes, billing cycles, or usage purchases.
- [Update key settings](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/update-key-settings.md): Update key properties in response to plan changes, subscription updates, or account status changes.
- [Verify API key](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/verify-api-key.md): Verify an API key's validity and permissions for request authentication.
- [Get API key by hash](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/keys/get-api-key-by-hash.md): Find out what key this is.
- [Create Identity](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/identities/create-identity.md): Create an identity to group multiple API keys under a single entity. Identities enable shared rate limits and metadata across all associated keys.
- [Delete Identity](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/identities/delete-identity.md): Permanently delete an identity. This operation cannot be undone.
- [Get Identity](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/identities/get-identity.md): Retrieve an identity by external ID. Returns metadata, rate limits, and other associated data.
- [List Identities](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/identities/list-identities.md): Get a paginated list of all identities in your workspace. Returns metadata and rate limit configurations.
- [Update Identity](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/identities/update-identity.md): Update an identity's metadata and rate limits. Only specified fields are modified - others remain unchanged.
- [Create permission](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/permissions/create-permission.md): Create a new permission to define specific actions or capabilities in your RBAC system. Permissions can be assigned directly to API keys or included in roles.
- [Create role](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/permissions/create-role.md): Create a new role to group related permissions for easier management. Roles enable consistent permission assignment across multiple API keys. Permission slugs supplied in `permissions` are attached during creation. Missing permissions are created automatically.
- [Delete permission](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/permissions/delete-permission.md): Remove a permission from your workspace. This also removes the permission from all API keys and roles.
- [Delete role](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/permissions/delete-role.md): Remove a role from your workspace. This also removes the role from all assigned API keys.
- [Get permission](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/permissions/get-permission.md): Retrieve details about a specific permission including its name, description, and metadata.
- [Get role](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/permissions/get-role.md): Retrieve details about a specific role including its assigned permissions.
- [List permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/permissions/list-permissions.md): Retrieve all permissions in your workspace. Results are paginated and sorted by their id.
- [List roles](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/permissions/list-roles.md): Retrieve all roles in your workspace including their assigned permissions. Results are paginated and sorted by their id.
- [Set role permissions](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/permissions/set-role-permissions.md): Atomically replaces all permissions directly assigned to a role. An empty `permissions` array removes every permission from the role. Permissions that do not exist are created when the caller has permission to create them.
- [Delete ratelimit override](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/ratelimit/delete-ratelimit-override.md): Permanently remove a rate limit override. Affected identifiers immediately revert to the namespace default.
- [Get ratelimit override](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/ratelimit/get-ratelimit-override.md): Retrieve the configuration of a specific rate limit override by its identifier.
- [Apply rate limiting](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/ratelimit/apply-rate-limiting.md): Check and enforce rate limits for any identifier (user ID, IP address, API client, etc.).
- [List ratelimit overrides](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/ratelimit/list-ratelimit-overrides.md): Retrieve a paginated list of all rate limit overrides in a namespace.
- [Apply multiple rate limit checks](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/ratelimit/apply-multiple-rate-limit-checks.md): Check and enforce multiple rate limits in a single request for any identifiers (user IDs, IP addresses, API clients, etc.).
- [Set ratelimit override](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/api-reference/ratelimit/set-ratelimit-override.md): Create or update a custom rate limit for specific identifiers, bypassing the namespace default.

CTEs, subqueries, UNION, and EXCEPT are supported. Queries are always restricted to the authenticated…

Queries must use one of the five public aliases: `key_verifications_v1`, `key_verifications_per_minute_v1`, `key_verifications_per_hour_v1`, `key_verifications_per_day_v1`, or `key_…
- [SDKs](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/sdks/overview.md): Official libraries for TypeScript, Go, and Python, plus a community Nuxt module.

- [Python SDK](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/sdks/python.md): Manage keys and rate limits from Python with unkey.py.
- [Nuxt module (community)](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/sdks/community/nuxt.md): A community-maintained Nuxt module for Unkey, and what to use for a supported setup.
- [@unkey/api](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/sdks/typescript/api.md): The generated TypeScript client for the whole Unkey API.
- [@unkey/ratelimit](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/sdks/typescript/ratelimit.md): Rate limit from serverless functions with a timeout fallback built in.
- [@unkey/hono](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/sdks/typescript/hono.md): Hono middleware that verifies API keys for you.
- [@unkey/nextjs](https://unkey.com/docs/api-management/sdks/typescript/nextjs.md): Wrap a Next.js route handler so only valid API keys reach it.
